name: "One More" Bar
description: The venue is a lively karaoke bar known for its friendly atmosphere and welcoming crowd. It offers a fun environment with great staff, clean spaces, and a good selection of drinks. The venue features karaoke nights that are popular among locals, with a focus on community and entertainment. While it doesn't specify private rooms, the emphasis on fun and socializing makes it a standout spot for karaoke enthusiasts looking for a relaxed yet engaging experience.
